request.what: Reduce the Cardano protocol parameter committeeMinSize from 7 to 5.

claims.claim: Intersect proposes reducing committeeMinSize from 7 to 5 to improve operational resilience while maintaining constitutional safeguards.
The current Constitutional Committee has 7 members, equal to the current committeeMinSize of 7.

If Constitutional Committee membership falls below committeeMinSize, governance actions requiring Constitutional Committee approval become ineligible for ratification, including parameter changes, constitution updates, treasury withdrawals, and hard forks.
Reducing committeeMinSize to 5 would allow governance to continue if one or two members retire or their terms expire, assuming a current 7-member body.
The proposal depends temporally on enactment of another live parameter-change action for Plutus cost models, but the document states there is no technical interaction between the changed parameters.
The Civics Committee approved submission of this governance action on 2026-03-13 and the Technical Steering Committee approved it on 2026-06-03.
At a committee size of 5 and a 2/3 Constitutional Committee threshold, 4 constitutional votes are needed to meet threshold and 2 unconstitutional votes can prevent threshold.
The proposer states this action has undergone technical review through the Parameter Committee Parameter Change Process and points to the Cardano Forum PCP-005 discussion.
The proposer states setting committeeMinSize to 5 satisfies the relevant guardrails that it must not be negative, lower than 3, or exceed 10.

The proposal states the change is reversible if needed, provided there are at least 7 Constitutional Committee members, but reverting to 7 while fewer than 7 members are present would immediately halt governance until enough members are elected.

summary: The document requests a non-treasury parameter change reducing committeeMinSize from 7 to 5, with rationale centered on avoiding governance inoperability, explicit threshold effects, external process references, guardrail analysis, and a conditional reversion plan.
